convert_nllb_moe_checkpoint: convert a fairseq NLLB-MoE sharded checkpoint to HuggingFace PyTorch format using CLI arguments
shard_moe_weights: shard MoE checkpoint weights into PyTorch bin files with an index and metadata JSON
rename_fairseq_keys: rename fairseq state dict keys to HuggingFace NLLB-MoE naming conventions
remove_ignore_keys: remove ignored keys like version strings and float tensors from a state dict
create_linear_from_embedding: create a Linear layer from an embedding layer's weight matrix
